Using marital platforms to convert criminal accountability into a digital grievance campaign.

Confusing personal narrative expression with institutional prison compliance rules.

Brand runs a smart selfish maneuver, weaponizing his media reach to project innocence and manufacture a grievance narrative while evading accountability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Convicted felons do not possess an untrammeled right to broadcast public proclamations from prison.

The Unavoidable Lie: Broadcasting grievance messages from confinement is merely routine podcasting.
